description: Search Gobkit's free CC0 low-poly 3D models (.glb). Rigged models carry named animation clips (idle, walk, attack, death …) — play them by name. Returns each model's direct .glb URL. Leave query empty to list everything of a kind.

animated.description: true = only rigged models with animation clips; false = only static props.

query.description: Words to look for in the model or pack name, e.g. 'shark', 'cashier', 'tree', 'trex'. Any word may match (more matches rank higher); everyday words such as 'dog', 'monster', 'enemy' or 'person' find the matching models.

name: search_models

animations.description: Exact clip names (case matters: idle vs Idle).

name.description: Model name; pass it to get_model.

total.description: How many models matched (results may be cut to limit).

title: Search free 3D models
